nvitk.measure.morpho.preprocess_taubin¶

Taubin smoothing of multi-label segmentations.

All processing functions are importable; edit the CONFIG block below only for direct single-case runs.

Attributes¶

INPUT_PATH

OUTPUT_DIR

OUTPUT_NAME

KEEP_LARGEST_COMPONENT

TAUBIN_ITERS

TAUBIN_LAMBDA

TAUBIN_MU

Functions¶

ensure_dir(→ None)

Create path (and parents) if missing; no-op otherwise.

load_segmentation(path)

Load a NIfTI label volume; returns (int32 data, affine, header).

save_segmentation(→ None)

Write data as an int16 NIfTI label volume, reusing affine/header.

keep_largest_component(→ numpy.ndarray)

Boolean mask of only the largest 26-connected component of mask.

signed_distance(→ numpy.ndarray)

Signed Euclidean distance field: negative inside mask, positive outside.

crop_with_padding(→ Tuple[numpy.ndarray, Tuple[slice, ...)

Tight bounding-box crop of mask with pad voxels of margin; returns (cropped, bbox_slices).

_laplacian(→ numpy.ndarray)

Discrete Laplacian of an n-d field (sum of second differences along each axis, normalized).

taubin_smooth_field(→ numpy.ndarray)

Taubin (λ/μ) smoothing of a scalar field: alternating Laplacian steps that resist shrinkage.

build_taubin_scores() → Dict[int, numpy.ndarray])

Per-label Taubin-smoothed signed-distance score map (cropped, then padded back to full shape).

fuse_from_scores(→ numpy.ndarray)

Re-fuse per-label score maps into one label volume: argmax label wins, 0 where all scores ≤ 0.

preprocess_segmentation() → numpy.ndarray)

Full Taubin-smoothing pipeline: score each label, then fuse back to one label volume.

main(→ None)

Direct-run entry point: smooth INPUT_PATH per the CONFIG block and write output + JSON report.

nvitk.measure.morpho.preprocess_taubin.build_taubin_scores(seg: numpy.ndarray, labels: Iterable[int], keep_largest: bool, taubin_iters: int, taubin_lambda: float, taubin_mu: float, skip_smoothing: Iterable[int] = ()) → Dict[int, numpy.ndarray]¶

Per-label Taubin-smoothed signed-distance score map (cropped, then padded back to full shape).

Each label’s SDF is used as a competing “fitness” score for fuse_from_scores(). Labels in skip_smoothing keep their raw (unsmoothed) SDF.
